idea-plugin.name: Agentforce Action Audit
idea-plugin.description:
13 rules on a Salesforce Agentforce topic file, before the deploy and before Article 50

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Agentforce Action Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/agentforce-action-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/agentforce-action-audit

action.text: Agentforce Action Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Agentforce Action Audit on the file in the editor
